column1: # provenance.tsv - every original source behind a claim in this directory.
# AGENTS.md §1.4: a claim may say "verified" or "bit-for-bit" ONLY if it names the
# external file the reference came from. This file IS that naming, one row per
# original. A row is added when a document is fetched and never edited to
# "refresh" a hash - a new version of a paper is a NEW row, because the old
# transcription was made against the old text.
# Read a transcription's own header for what was read (full text, abstract only,
# the authors' code). Tier language lives in docs/protocols/ORACLE.md.
# columns  file | kind | source | version | source_date | bytes | sha256 | fetched
